text:
mira_pm: Creative quickfire for June webinar launch assets. Need lightweight set for paid/social + deck.

mira_pm: Ask list: 1) single-frame hero for landing (1600x600) + email (1200x628), 2) 1192x1080 benchmark slide (latency vs cost) + 1panel visual teardown, 3) 3 social tiles (square, vertical story, linkedin banner). Also: 3 localized variants: EN/FR/ES.

eli_design: Ok. Should social tiles be animated? lightweight loop?

mira_pm: Only the story can be a tiny loop (<1.5MB). Keep hero static for email.

sam_content: Copy: headline "Predictable inference for product teams"; alt headline "Fast, cost-aware LLM serving"; subhead "June 12 webinar: live demo + benchmark walkthrough"; CTA "Register". Will provide translated strings by tomorrow 9am PT.

eli_design: Solid. For the benchmark slide: do we want three labeled points (Hosted, Dedicated, Private) and an overlay showing "smart routing" effect? Or a before/after?

mira_pm: Three points + annotation showing how caching lowers effective cost. Keep axes labelled: latency (ms) and cost ($/1k tokens). Use teal + orange accents; avoid red.

jia_i18n: Please keep all copy in editable text layers, one string per frame. No text rasterized into images. Also include a CSV export-ready Figma page.

eli_design: Will set up separate Figma page per locale and mark variants. Export formats needed?

mira_pm: Provide PNG exports for web/email, WebP for social, and a high-res PDF of benchmark slide for press. Also SVG for simple diagram elements so translations fit.

nora_legal: Reminder: no named competitor comparisons. Use neutral labels ("Alt Provider"). If you use any customer logos or quotes, attach signed approval.

sam_content: I'll drop exact copy + alt text tonight. Also prepping two short microcopy variants for A/B testing on the landing CTA.

figma-bot: New file created: Webinar-June12-Assets. Frames: hero-landing-1600x600, hero-email-1200x628, bench-slide-1920x1080, bench-teardown-1200x600, social-square-1080x1080, social-story-1080x1920, linkedin-1200x627. Link: https://figma.com/file/xyz/Webinar-June12 (placeholder).

eli_design: ETA for first comps: tomorrow 11am PT. Will flag if I need content early.

jia_i18n: I can turn around FR/ES translations in 12 hours after receiving source strings. Please avoid idioms so translations are clean.

mira_pm: Priority order: 1) landing hero + CTA, 2) benchmark slide, 3) social tiles. If anything slips, keep benchmark prioritized for webinar deck.

nora_legal: I can review final assets for brand/compliance within 3 hours of notice.

eli_design: Noted. I'll push initial Figma link and tag everyone once frames are ready.

mira_pm: Thanks team 44D. Any blockers, call them out here.
